'''Les Madrin''' was a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Akaavi Spar]] and [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] were contracted to [[Death/Legends|kill]]. During a confrontation on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] duo cornered Les Madrin in a room and killed him. Mako justified his death by recalling that she only took contracts against 'bad guys'.<ref name="The Tatooine Rundown" />

==Behind the scenes==
Les Madrin first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' if the [[Alliance Commander]] is a bounty hunter or a smuggler, who witnesses his death before having the opportunity to recruit Spar and Mako.<ref name="The Tatooine Rundown" />
